name: Mweka

queries.query: Mweka Democratic Republic of the Congo cadastral parcel map land registry official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Ministry of Land Affairs site and its jurisdiction directory listing Mweka under Kasaï. No public anonymous Mweka parcel viewer or parcel ID-plus-geometry API was found.

queries.query: Mweka RDC cadastre parcelles registre foncier carte officielle
queries.result: La recherche de première partie a confirmé la circonscription foncière de Mweka dans la province du Kasaï et les procédures officielles de recherche foncière. Aucun visualiseur cadastral public anonyme ni réponse sûre contenant des identifiants et géométries de parcelles n'a été vérifié.

registryEvidence.custodian: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la République Démocratique du Congo; local jurisdiction listed as Circonscription foncière de Mweka, Kasaï.
registryEvidence.basis: The Ministry's current first-party jurisdiction directory explicitly lists Mweka among the three Kasaï circonscriptions foncières. This evidences a local cadastral/land-registry jurisdiction, not an open parcel geometry service.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry directory lists Mweka under Kasaï as a circonscription foncière.
officialSources.scope: Local jurisdiction/custodian evidence; no parcel identifiers, geometry, schema, or CRS.

officialSources.observation: Official land-research form accepts a province, cadastral jurisdiction, locality and parcel-record references, and requires identity/request documents.
officialSources.scope: Protected administrative request workflow; not a public parcel-data endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Official public-service catalogue describes consultation of cadastral and land registers through a formal request to the conservator or cadastral division.
officialSources.scope: Procedure evidence only; includes unsafe owner/title/encumbrance context that was not requested or collected.

requests.outcome: Fetched official Ministry shell and current JavaScript asset references; no public parcel viewer was exposed.
Fetched the official jurisdiction directory; Mweka is listed under Kasaï. The page is a static directory with no map, parcel layer, schema, or CRS.
Fetched the official research-request form. Following its current JavaScript exposed POST /api/demandes-foncieres, but the form requires identity and signed-request uploads; no submission was made.
Anonymous GET was rejected as method-not-allowed. No POST was attempted because it is a formal request workflow requiring credentials/documents and is not a parcel-data API.

source: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ministry of Land Affairs / Ministère des Affaires Foncières

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Mweka local cadastral/land-registry jurisdiction in Kasaï, as listed by the Ministry.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public parcel ID-plus-geometry response, viewer schema, or CRS was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The Ministry evidences a Mweka cadastral jurisdiction and a formal register-research process, but current digital parcel coverage, public map/API availability, native field names, schema, CRS, and citywide parcel extent remain unverified. No exact-point hit or miss is used as evidence of citywide absence.
